name: Hermes Agent v0.23.1
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.1

**Release Date:** November 9, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~618 PRs merged since v0.23.0 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

**What this patch ships for plugin users:** since the plugin catalog's site deploy on November 9, the published `plugin-catalog.json` was larger than the 2 MiB cap clients accept, so every install silently fell back to the catalog it shipped with. `hermes plugins install <name>` could not find plugins added since your last update, installed the pin your release shipped instead of the current one, and missed newer `removed` entries. This release raises the cap to 16 MiB, so the live catalog is used again ([#151860](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/151860), fixes [#151856](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues/151856), thanks @100yenadmin). Installs that stay on v0.23.0 or older keep falling back until they update.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `3b421578588`, the window since v0.23.0 contains **2,578 non-merge commits** across **2,781 changed files** (+151,690 / −62,595), **618 merged PRs** and **409 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: Esc backtrack in the TUI and classic CLI (replacing the rewind list picker), group chats that run on a gateway without Desktop and can seat bots from other computers, saved gateway connections shared by Desktop and the Webapp, signing the in-app browser in with your real browser profile and filling saved logins from its address bar, `hermes gateway attach` for local clients, `hermes clipboard image --json`, new plugin API (session-scoped environment values, plugin JSON-RPC methods and events, `llm.oneshot` auxiliary tasks, a compression-stable `conversation_id`, an `on_session_open` hook in the gateway, a `post_curator_run` hook), faster transcript and handoff reads, and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.0...v0.23.1](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.0...v0.23.1)

name: v0.9.30
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.30

Released on 2026-11-10.

Studio stays responsive on large projects while it keeps history. The preview server now refuses writes from other sites and host names it does not serve, so a tunnel or remote setup may need one setting.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** When `hyperframes reverse` needs you to sign in, the agent now tells you why in one message with the link (and the device code on a remote terminal). The reverse skill also spots an outdated CLI install and runs the latest release instead ([007664e25](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/007664e25a587c35da0ea104d7fc6a8550389446), [#7488](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7488)).
- **AWS Lambda:** The Lambda handler ZIP installs its runtime from a committed lockfile, with install scripts turned off ([f9255e39a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f9255e39a56de17fd86362c4558a918ad2a874ef), [#7485](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7485)).
- **Studio Server:** On large projects, Studio's history checks no longer hold up the server ([61e720b0e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/61e720b0e7d6d68172466a3a72ea27d98f2ad58d), [#7491](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7491)).
- **Gcp Cloud Run:** The Cloud Run image pins its base image and checks its browser and bun downloads by checksum ([c6d243a2d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c6d243a2dee879e5f1fa2aeda544de8ecf91a998), [#7487](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7487)).
- **Studio Server:** The preview server refuses writes from other sites and requests for host names it does not serve. Local use needs no change. If you open `hyperframes preview` or the Studio dev server through a tunnel, Codespaces or a remote dev host, that setup can now be refused with a 403: name the host in `HYPERFRAMES_PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOSTS` (comma separated), for example `HYPERFRAMES_PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOSTS=demo.tunnels.example hyperframes preview` ([f318d3d08](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f318d3d08a7dff5fb48d12e7604c73bf004af204), [#7490](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7490)).

## Full changelog

# HyperFrames v0.9.29

Released on 2026-11-10.

Undo no longer loses work caught in the middle of a save, and the CLI shows the credits an image actually cost. Fewer renders are wrongly refused as too slow, and every frame of a video clip shows its own source frame.

## Features

- **CLI:** Label GPT image prices as estimates and show the charged credits ([0ba894123](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0ba8941235f7bb3b40e10bb79bd27130543718c3), [#7351](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7351)).

## Fixes

- **Studio Server:** History waits out a file a save has emptied, and rereads one written mid-copy ([e8416b2a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e8416b2a41e537ed2f0c56e66a8ce585d1fb5b01), [#7480](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7480)).
- **Producer:** Refuse a too-slow render only when its typical frame says it cannot finish ([88db83092](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/88db83092a635b9e3ef2b7f90e2f50261e8e5cdb), [#7479](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7479)).
- **Engine:** A video clip shows a new source frame on every frame it is on screen ([235c80bae](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/235c80bae0cde99754cab78609cb5d7d210b650e), [#7471](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7471)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Studio App:** The Reference read is paid by Pro or a saved HeyGen API key ([b12365d67](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b12365d67d8436c8537c0d3de7a6717b1519a509), [#7440](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7440)).

## Internal

- **Engine:** Split the frame extractor tests so each file stays under the flake gate budget ([1a758fd60](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1a758fd60fac90cd3ce370f5af1cb47e4b610128), [#7476](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7476)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.27

Released on 2026-11-09.

Studio renders now wait for the same one-at-a-time render slot as the CLI, so two renders no longer split one machine between them. Long project paths on Windows and the macOS developer-tools prompt are fixed too.

## Features

- **Skills:** Route a style outside the templates instead of listing them ([37f1819f3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/37f1819f32cf0b1329f2241295dbad9a3dea354e), [#7450](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7450)).

name: v0.47.0
body:
## New features

- Review daily problems in the Friction Log, including corrections, tool errors, and recurring patterns linked to exact messages. Browse dates, download Markdown, or read findings through the CLI and MCP. Enable it with `[friction] enabled = true`.
- Turn Friction Log patterns into Kata issues, link existing issues, or remove links from the page or CLI. Enable hourly automatic filing with `[friction.kata] auto_file = true`.
- Generate an optional model-written Friction Log summary with your configured insights provider. Summaries run only when requested and stay attached to the reviewed digest.
- Find the recorded session and prompt behind code with `agentsview why file.go:120-140` or `agentsview why --commit <sha>`. List a session's recorded commits with `agentsview session commits <id>`.
- Turn on search by meaning from Settings or the search palette without editing configuration or restarting. Local installations use an available Ollama server or download the built-in embedding server with progress.
- Find sessions covering two to five concepts through MCP or the content search API. Results include a supporting passage for each concept.
- Browse saved Claude and Codex history from Docbank archives or backup snapshots alongside local sessions. Imported history remains searchable when the archive is disconnected.
- Find matching Docbank file versions beneath retained transcript images and attachments. The optional integration also exposes matches through the API and MCP.
- Import Open Interpreter sessions with their own label, usage totals, and resume commands. Command Code v3 sessions also import with thinking, tool calls, and token usage.
- Browse Kiro CLI subagent runs beneath their launching sessions, including nested subagents. The launching transcript shows each delegation's prompt and result.
- Choose message colors and a Color-blind safe chart palette in Settings > Appearance. Optional message markers, chart patterns, and dashed trend lines distinguish content beyond color alone.
- Diagnose an expensive session with `agentsview session diagnose <id>`. The report combines usage, context growth, compactions, large tool results, retry runs, and child-session links.
- Inspect per-session tokens and costs through MCP `get_session_usage`, including model totals and request breakdowns. Batch CLI lookups use `agentsview session usage-batch <id>...`.
- Import xAI billing CSV files with `agentsview usage grok <csv>`. Reimports deduplicate billing records, but overlapping local sessions or Cursor billing imports may double count usage.
- Filter hosted sessions, searches, analytics, and usage by contributing source devices. Sessions supplied by several selected devices count once.
- Run PostgreSQL serving and watched local ingestion together with `agentsview replica pg serve --push-watch`. Add `--embed` to build and publish embeddings in the same process.
- Export visible dialogue with `--text-mode visible`, omitting structured tool and reasoning content. Reporting exports support hourly snapshots by originating machine with `--schema-version 5 --by-machine`.
- Discover commands from a task description with `agentsview cli search`. Inspect supported agents, session folders, and captured details with `agentsview agents`, without a daemon or archive.

## Improvements

- Usage loads faster on large archives. In separate 30,000-session benchmarks, repeat visits drop from about 24 seconds to under a second on PostgreSQL and DuckDB.
- Activity, Signals, Trends, and session statistics load faster through reduced reads and reuse of unchanged results. ClickHouse session navigation also stays responsive while dashboard queries run.
- Session lists and long transcripts open and scroll with fewer stalls. Sidebar rows appear before their titles finish loading, and code highlighting blocks the page less.
- Sidebar and content searches return sooner, including substring, regex, and multi-term searches. The first local startup after upgrading builds a new search index before serving requests.
- Imports, archive rebuilds, and live Claude and Codex updates finish sooner. PostgreSQL pushes preserve unchanged transcript sections, DuckDB rebuilds write faster, and S3 sync reuses shared Codex parent downloads.
- Usage charts refresh automatically while visible and catch up when you return. Hidden tabs cancel pending Usage queries instead of holding browser connections.
- Usage charts omit zero-value tooltip rows and group positive series below 0.5% into Other. Token Attribution adds Linear, Sqrt, and Log choices for treemap label sizes.
- Activity timelines merge narrow bars into readable time intervals on smaller screens while preserving totals and selection accuracy.
- Read Claude hook-command output in collapsible cards controlled by the Hooks filter. Hook text is searchable and appears in HTML and Markdown exports.
- See recorded reasoning effort on Pi-family and Posit Assistant messages.
- Use grouped CLI commands under `source`, `report`, `replica`, and `index`. Previous spellings remain available for at least one release and print their replacements. Failures include specific recovery hints and structured JSON diagnostics where supported.
- Reduce background work while idle or on battery. Local sync pauses after ten idle minutes and resumes on archive access; scheduled embedding builds, Recall model passes, and archive audits wait for AC power. Set `sync_interval` to adjust watcher-triggered sync frequency.
- Keep using AgentsView while Claude.ai Sync runs by closing its dialog; only Stop cancels the run within the page. Closing or reloading the page still ends Sync. An organization allowlist also limits future imports after a restart.
- Recover useful search results when search by meaning is unavailable. Hybrid CLI and MCP searches return keyword matches with an explanation, and empty searches report matches hidden by session filters.
- Check stalled PostgreSQL and ClickHouse push watchers with status `--max-stale`. Status reports failed, overdue, or unfinished pushes with a nonzero exit code.

## Bug fixes

- Usage totals include blank Claude thinking responses, unfinished Copilot CLI sessions, and Hermes or Augure Desktop background model calls.
- Codex Fast-tier sessions use Fast rate estimates. ClickHouse and DuckDB use the latest Copilot-reported session cost.
- VS Code Copilot and Positron replies keep updating as they grow, preserve pins and notes through rebuilds and pushes, and render without duplicate-tool-call failures.
- DeepSeek Harness sessions import when logs contain job lifecycle events or compressed frames without checksums.
- Claude channel and peer messages remain visible and searchable. Slash commands containing `<` in their arguments no longer disappear or leave answers beneath the wrong prompt.
- Codex forks link to their source sessions. Pi subagent runs and OMP parent links also receive the correct relationships.
- Archive rebuilds complete despite unavailable Codex fork parents while preserving saved child history. The Sync button performs required rebuilds and reports failures.
- Remote and temporary worktree sessions reuse established repository project names when recorded repository evidence supports the match. Explicit assignments and mapping rules retain priority.
- All-history Usage opens during startup price refreshes without internal errors. Concurrent Usage requests in a new time zone avoid database-lock failures.
- Analytics panels remain usable when another panel fails. Failed panels show their own error and Retry control, and old filter results no longer appear current.
- Activity's Sessions table keeps its selected sort order and column widths after syncs.
- Desktop windows reconnect after daemon exits or endpoint changes, accept localhost and IPv6 loopback endpoints, and avoid reloads caused by archive contention. The Linux AppImage also starts on affected Wayland systems.
- Explicitly started daemons stay running until stopped. Daemon restart also completes in Linux containers whose exited children remain unreaped.
- Claude and Codex Cloud transcripts show generated images inline with full-size viewing. Codex code-mode `wait` calls show their returned output, and Codex Cloud tool calls no longer appear twice.
- Hosted search and session browsing remain consistent during incoming uploads and publication. Empty source files upload successfully, and permanent upload rejections stop retrying indefinitely.
- Background skill discovery avoids protected macOS folders by default. Live watches recover after macOS session folders are recreated, and large Linux archives retain watches beyond 8,192 folders.
- Transcript-only archives stop reporting retries based solely on repeated tool names. Session links using an unambiguous raw UUID also open correctly.

name: v1.17.0 - Safe upgrades, 2.0 notice
body:
## What's New in v1.17.0

`openspec update` now upgrades a project from any older release in one run, and announces that command files go away in OpenSpec 2.0.

> **Heads-up: command files (`/opsx:*`) go away in OpenSpec 2.0.** Your OpenSpec skills stay and do the same work. To switch now, run `openspec config set delivery skills && openspec update`. The plan is in [#2022](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/issues/2022).

### New

- **2.0 notice** - While a configured tool still gets command files, `openspec update` ends with a short notice that they go away in 2.0, plus the one command to switch early. It stays silent once you use skills only, and for tools without command files, such as Codex.

### Improved

- **Upgrades from any release** - `openspec update` now upgrades a project made by any release since 0.12 in one run, without stopping to ask for `--force`. It removes old OpenSpec files nobody edited, including leftover copies that made some tools show every skill twice, and keeps any file you changed.
- **Safer cleanup** - Cleanup never touches files outside your project, even when a folder inside it links somewhere else, and never removes anything when a tool fails to set up.

### Fixed

- **Switching to skills only** - `openspec config set delivery skills` followed by `openspec update` no longer deletes command files you edited. Only files OpenSpec generated are removed; edited ones are kept and listed.
- **Windows installer** - `irm https://openspec.dev/cli/install.ps1 | iex` no longer fails with `unsupported CPU` on Windows PowerShell 5.1 machines that report no CPU architecture.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/compare/v1.16.1...v1.17.0

name: v18.18.6
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Fixed

- LiteLLM lists only the models the configured key can call (its authenticated `/v1/models`), keeping the proxy's metadata for them; a proxy whose `/v1/models` fails now lists no models instead of every model it serves ([#18601](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18601))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- In Tern, a turn's long-press menu on a phone can edit and resend a prompt, retry the turn, open the rewind page on it, or fork the session from it into a new session
- A rewind from the transcript says how many turns it dropped and offers Undo on its toast in Tern, which puts the turns and your draft back

### Changed

- Browser `role/` selectors in Chrome tabs now match the role and name Chrome's accessibility tree reports, so they reach open shadow roots and skip hidden elements; in Tern every name `observe()` reports selects its element again ([#18632](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18632) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- A late usage-limit error from a previous provider no longer blocks or cools down the selected provider; when the old provider has spent its retry budget, a replay-safe turn still tries the selected model without the old quota delay ([#17098](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17098), [#17571](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17571) by [@Bensonluo](https://github.com/Bensonluo))
- Multi-question ask forms in Tern show Submit on the last question tab, not only on the Review tab
- MCP `headers` and stdio `env` values that use `!command` now run again on a 401/403 (the request is retried once), on `/mcp reconnect` and other reconnects, and on `/mcp reload`, so servers whose command mints short-lived tokens keep working past expiry instead of staying 401 until restart ([#18631](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18631))
- Pausing an unapproved plan no longer tells the agent that the draft was approved or to continue executing it, and pausing with `/plan` closes an open plan review so it can no longer save and execute the plan ([#18610](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18610)).
- Turning off `lsp.enabled` now also stops `write` and `edit` from starting language servers for diagnostics or formatting; previously only the `lsp` tool was disabled ([#18205](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18205), [#18490](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18490) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed background tabs omp borrows (relay `app.target`, `app.cdp_url`) ignoring omp's clicks and keys or timing out on hover and drag; the page reads as visible while omp drives it and hidden again once released ([#17831](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17831) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the transcript jumping at the screen's top edge while scrolled back during a streamed reply, and the screen dropping two rows when a reply finished ([#12307](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12307), [#16117](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16117) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk))
- Focusing a subagent or returning to the main session no longer loses or freezes the next assistant reply when a fast tool turn finishes before the previous reply's links finish resolving, and messages and tool runs that arrive during the switch show exactly once, in order ([#18564](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18564) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- `omp gc --strip` now keeps every response of the latest replay turn (including earlier tool-call steps joined by their tool results), reference-only images, and the transcript's file permissions ([#18636](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18636) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Session files whose entries were written without ids are re-indexed when loaded, and migrating old sessions no longer gives two entries the same id ([#18636](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18636) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- `wait` and `write proc://<id>/kill` now say how a settled job's result reached the caller: delivered by the call itself (it finished while the call ran), handed over by this snapshot (it superseded the job's queued completion push, so no duplicate follows), or genuinely late — the last keeps its "not auto-delivered; recovered by this snapshot" warning and adds how long before the call it had finished ([#16052](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16052), [#18635](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18635) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed `ask` notes added with `n` right after picking an answer landing on the previous question instead of the one shown; a Tern click then Note still notes the answer just clicked, and the Note button names it ([#18317](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18317) by [@DonMikone](https://github.com/DonMikone))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Fixed GTK4 apps such as Files (Nautilus) on X11: element clicks and `computer.elementAt()` now find their elements where they are on screen, and `ax()` no longer marks their enabled controls `(disabled)` ([#18643](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18643) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `grep` no longer searches the file its own output is redirected into, nor standard input redirected from that same file: both are refused with `input file is also the output`, as GNU grep does ([#14808](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14808), [#16489](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16489) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- The `wait` result's `JobSnapshot` now carries `settledAtMs` (epoch ms when the run settled, absent while it is still running), so a snapshot can tell a result that finished during the call from one recovered from an earlier, never-delivered completion ([#18635](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18635) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Added a `thinking.set` composer action so Tern's phone effort menu can pick a thinking level in one tap
- Added All, Running, Done and Parked status scopes with counts to the agent hub's roster, so Tern's phone can filter agents by status
- A prompt and a turn's answer list their actions for a phone's long press (`actions.hold`): Copy, Edit & resend (a prompt's), Retry turn, Rewind to here… and Fork from here; the desktop keeps its hover toolbars
- A click or tap on a turn on the native rewind page picks it, and the rewind selector can open on a given turn (`startAt`)
- A status notice can carry a button on its native toast (`StatusNoticeAction`), such as the Undo after a rewind

### Fixed

- Fixed streamed rows being clipped above the screen before they reached scrollback while the working row was up, so a scrolled-back terminal saw rows jump at the screen's top edge and the whole screen dropped when a run ended ([#12307](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12307), [#16117](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16117) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk)). `Composer.setRuntimeChildren` takes a `billedChrome` option for roots billed at their current height instead of through the floor.
- Fixed rows of a streaming reply, and the top rows of a table taller than the screen, going missing from both the screen and scrollback with `tui.completeScrollback` on; such a table now keeps the column widths it had when it outgrew the screen ([#16355](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16355) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- `actions.hold` (`TspMenuEntry[]`): what a long press on a touch screen offers, beside `actions.menu`; and `toast`'s `action` / `label` props for a button on the toast


## What's Changed
* fix(coding-agent): keep late quota errors off the fallback provider by @Bensonluo in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17571
* fix(builtins): refuse to grep the file grep writes its output to by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16489
* fix(mcp): re-ran command-backed headers on 401 and reconnect by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18633
* fix(plan): prevent unapproved drafts from becoming execution references by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18615
* fix(catalog): scoped litellm discovery to virtual keys by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18602
* fix(coding-agent): gate write/edit LSP writethrough on lsp.enabled by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18490
* test(natives): unset LIBEI_SOCKET under the env lock in the Wayland no-portal test by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18649
* fix(coding-agent): resolve Chromium role selectors through Chrome's accessibility tree by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18632
* fix(coding-agent): let background relay and app.cdp_url tabs take omp's clicks and keys by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17831
* fix(tui): completeScrollback commits a streaming reply's rows, tall tables included, as they leave the screen by @galtamam-cmyk in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16355
* fix(tui): commit streamed rows as they leave the screen while the working row is up by @galtamam-cmyk in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16117
* fix(tui): serialize live events after focus attachment by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18564
* fix(coding-agent): preserve the latest replay turn during gc stripping by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18636
* fix(coding-agent): label a wait-delivered result accurately (#16052) by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18635
* fix(natives): find GTK4 app elements on X11 and stop marking them disabled by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18643

## New Contributors
* @Bensonluo made their first contribution in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17571

name: v18.18.4
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added the `base64SkipThoughtSignature` compat flag so Gemini gateways that decode `thoughtSignature` as base64 (such as the Hyperspace AI LLM proxy) can receive the unsigned-tool-call bypass sentinel without rejecting the request with a 400 ([#18586](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18586) by [@tuandinh0801](https://github.com/tuandinh0801)).

### Changed

- Providers paused by a `disabled` auth rule (currently Google Antigravity) are left out of the built-in login list, refuse login, token refresh and usage probes, resolve no key from any source, and refuse requests and image generation with the pause reason; stored logins are kept and work again once the rule is removed, and an extension that registers its own login under the paused id takes it back ([#18622](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18622) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Exclusive tools (`edit`, `write`, `eval`, …) called as Cursor MCP tools now keep their place in the tool batch, so a shell or read sent with an edit no longer runs against the old file or starts before an earlier call finishes ([#18502](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18502) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Otari gateway provider: `/login otari` with `OTARI_API_KEY`, models discovered live per workspace ([#17841](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17841) by [@tbille](https://github.com/tbille))
- Added the `base64SkipThoughtSignature` Google compat flag, which sends the Gemini unsigned-tool-call bypass sentinel base64-encoded for gateways that decode `thoughtSignature` as bytes ([#18586](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18586) by [@tuandinh0801](https://github.com/tuandinh0801)).
- Added a `disabled "<reason>"` auth rule that pauses a provider: no login offers it and nothing calls it, while its code and users' stored logins stay in place ([#18622](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18622) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Changed

- Paused Google Antigravity, since Google may restrict accounts that use it outside its own apps ([#18622](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18622) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- SDK: `PromptOptions.followUps` queues prompts to run after the prompt, in order; if the prompt never reaches the agent they come back with it in `DroppedPrompt.followUps`

### Changed

- The `task` tool no longer advertises a per-call `model` field unless `task.perCallModel` is `on` or the bundled seance is spawnable; a `model` sent anyway is still refused before dispatch ([#18554](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18554) by [@xiangnan0811](https://github.com/xiangnan0811))

### Fixed

- `/usage`, session statistics, and `omp stats` now include session title spend from both the default fork title and the tiny title model, and tiny-model titles count toward `--max-cost` ([#18177](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18177), [#18491](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18491) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Retries after `--model pi/<role>` (or `@<role>`, `<role>`) now walk that role's `retry.fallbackChains` entry instead of the `default` chain, including on `--continue` ([#18389](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18389), [#18534](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18534) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))
- Fixed a `->` / `=>` list sent to an idle session running its second item before its first; if the first item can't start (Esc, a refused or failed setup), the whole list goes back to the editor ([#10802](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/10802))
- Fixed auto-compaction repeating every turn when the system prompt and tool schemas alone exceed the compaction budget; it now warns once instead ([#18589](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18589)).
- Fixed a blank per-call `model` (`""` or whitespace) failing the gate for task calls, eval `agent()` and eval `workpool()` instead of using the agent's configured model ([#18576](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18576) by [@iwangjie](https://github.com/iwangjie))
- `task` tool calls with an empty model string or empty model array now use the agent's normal model routing ([#18554](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18554) by [@xiangnan0811](https://github.com/xiangnan0811))
- Fixed `todo append` without a phase failing instead of adding tasks to the active phase, the last phase, or a new `Tasks` phase ([#17265](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17265), [#18575](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18575) by [@taotao7](https://github.com/taotao7)).
- Learned-only memory guidance no longer tells the model to read a missing `memory_summary.md` ([#18523](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18523) by [@nick-maderight](https://github.com/nick-maderight)).
- A `wait` that times out now says how long it waited and how long a back-to-back wait allows, instead of returning a bare still-running snapshot that agents read as an empty result, and the back-to-back reminder tells agents not to start `sleep` jobs to wait longer ([#18612](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18612) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm)).
- `auth-gateway stdio` now follows a role's configured fallback chain even when `modelRoles` does not set the role (a chat role without its own chain inherits the `default` chain) ([#18509](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18509) by [@enieuwy](https://github.com/enieuwy))
- In the Pseudo shell visualization, a `;`-separated chain no longer draws its statement separators as rows of their own, so `echo a; echo b` reads as two statements ([#18258](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18258), [#18497](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18497) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Autoresearch `update_notes` with `append_idea` now creates an `## Ideas` section instead of inserting the bullet before the first heading when notes contain only a similarly named heading such as `## Ideas backlog` or `### Ideas` ([#18505](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18505) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Exclusive tools (`edit`, `write`, `eval`, …) called as Cursor MCP tools now keep their place in the tool batch, so a check sent right after an edit sees the new file and an edit no longer starts before an earlier read finishes ([#18502](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18502) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Quarantined Hindsight memories are now deleted once their 30-day review period ends even when no new memory is quarantined ([#18504](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18504) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- The compaction display summary no longer requests reasoning, so thinking models return a summary instead of spending the 512-token cap on reasoning and returning nothing ([#18541](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18541) by [@phillipxkang](https://github.com/phillipxkang))
- Retries on the same model now stop after three consecutive generic aborts instead of spending the whole retry budget ([#18535](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18535) by [@nick-maderight](https://github.com/nick-maderight))
- `lsp.formatOnWrite` no longer re-indents 2/4-space files at 1 space per level when they contain JSDoc/block comments or one-off odd indents, and no longer converts tab-indented files that open with a JSDoc block to spaces ([#18544](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18544))
- Isolated task sandboxes now finish cleanup after a SIGHUP or other signal even when releasing them takes longer than the agent shutdown grace period ([#18519](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18519)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed late background embedding writes overwriting newer vectors for updated memories or recreating vectors for deleted memories ([#18503](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18503) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Fixed a second `Mnemopi` instance configured for a different local embedding model silently reusing the first instance's encoder while stamping its vectors with the configured model: local encoders are now cached per model, and a failed load evicts only that model's entry ([#18562](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18562) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Fixed

- Fixed `omp stats` re-parsing every unchanged session after a filesystem's device number changes, such as across ZFS remounts ([#14736](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14736)) ([#18536](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18536) by [@Alex-Wengg](https://github.com/Alex-Wengg)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- `ask` HTML forms with two or more `<fieldset>`s show one tab per question plus a Review tab in Tern; Next moves on, ←/→ and PgUp/PgDn switch tabs, and Submit lives on Review ([#18608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18608) by [@Gabriel-Hiss](https://github.com/Gabriel-Hiss))
- `ask` HTML forms hide to one row with `app.ask.hide` (`Alt+H`) or the Hide button, as the ask dialog does ([#18608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18608) by [@Gabriel-Hiss](https://github.com/Gabriel-Hiss))

### Fixed

- Prefilled single-line `ask` fields now open at the start of their value instead of scrolling to the end when focused ([#18585](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18585)).
- Fixed the `│` rails of a wrapped box-drawing tree line (`├── **label**: …`) taking the color and weight of the node's leading bold, italic or code span under colorful Markdown; continuation rails now match the first row's rails and the node text keeps its own styling ([#18584](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18584) by [@chan1103](https://github.com/chan1103))
- Fixed relayed Windows terminal events after an event-loop stall so they neither abort the running turn nor type TSP data into the composer ([#18512](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18512)).
- Fixed transcript rows a few turns above the composer disappearing from the screen and from scrollback, at a place that moved with every resize, while a todo list or subagent panel stayed up after a turn ([#18510](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18510) by [@mccraigmccraig](https://github.com/mccraigmccraig))
- Fixed `xd://<device>:raw` and `xd://<device>:conflicts` resolving as that device. Those suffixes stay in the name, so the read or write no longer runs the device ([#18561](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18561) by [@wisehead](https://github.com/wisehead))
- Fixed `ask` HTML forms taller than the composer area being cut off and unscrollable in Tern: the form now scrolls in the composer's place, and Cancel/Submit stay visible
- Fixed the Agent Hub in Tern freezing itself and the session behind it once hundreds of agents are listed: moving the selection no longer re-sends every roster row, and live roster updates on large hubs are batched (up to once a second) so the terminal keeps up

name: v1.5.2
body:
### New Features

- **Fork sessions whose folder is gone**: when a session's original folder was moved or deleted, you can now fork it into the current folder instead of only continuing, so later resumes no longer ask. See [Continue or switch sessions](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.2/packages/coding-agent/docs/sessions.md#continue-or-switch-sessions).

### Changed

- When a session's working directory no longer exists, for example after the project folder was renamed, interactive mode now offers `Continue`, `Fork`, or `Cancel` instead of only continuing. `Continue` runs the session in the current directory without storing the choice, as before; `Fork` copies it into the current directory as a new session with a new ID, like `--fork`, so the next resume no longer asks. This applies at startup (`--session`, `--resume`), to `/resume`, to `/import`, and to `ctx.switchSession()` from extensions ([#11975](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11975) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll), fixes [#11060](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11060))

### Fixed

- Fixed `/import` of a session whose working directory no longer exists leaving a copy in the session directory, and continuing it leaving a second copy with the same ID (`s.jsonl` and `s-1.jsonl`); the failed copy is now removed ([#11975](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11975) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll), fixes [#11060](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11060))
- Fixed Anthropic OAuth requests reporting an outdated Claude Code version

name: v1.5.1
body:
### New Features

- **Shell login and logout**: use `pi auth login <provider>` and `pi auth logout <provider>` without starting a session, with API-key and no-browser sign-in options. See [Credential commands](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#credential-commands).
- **Idle prompt cache warming**: eligible caches now stay warm for up to 30 minutes between runs when a refresh is expected to pay for itself. See [`cacheWarming`](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md#model-and-thinking).
- **Anthropic message threads**: requests send only new messages while the server continues the conversation, with full-request fallback when earlier context changes. See [Anthropic compatibility](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/models-configuration.md#anthropic-messages).
- **Richer Mermaid diagrams**: pie charts, author-defined styles, clickable labels on supported terminals, and diagrams in expanded branch and compaction summaries. See [Display settings](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md#terminal-and-display) and [Markdown transformers](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md#piregistermarkdowntransformertransformer-options).
- **GitHub Copilot classifiers**: call Microsoft-Decision-1 through codemode `models.classify()` for typed decisions and probabilities. See [Use classifier models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/models.md#use-classifier-models).
- **Package update summaries**: `pi update --extensions` reports each package's npm version or git commit change and distinguishes unchanged, skipped, and warned updates. See [Update Pi or packages](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#update-pi-or-packages).

### Breaking Changes

- Custom `GrepOperations.readFile` callbacks are no longer called for context lines. The field remains accepted as optional and deprecated so existing integrations still compile. The grep tool now takes context lines from ripgrep and no longer reads matched files itself. To search a remote system, override grep's `execute()`; see [Remote Execution](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.1/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md#remote-execution) ([#9276](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9276))
- OpenAI-compatible models no longer send `"tools": []` when all tools are disabled in a session that has used tools; the field is omitted. This fixes 400 errors (`tools must not be an empty array`) from vLLM 0.20+, also behind LiteLLM. If your proxy requires `tools` once the history has tool calls, such as older LiteLLM versions in front of Anthropic, set `compat.requiresToolsWithToolHistory: true` for that model in `models.json` ([#11843](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11843))

### Added

- `pi update` now lists each updated package with its npm version or git commit change, for example `npm:foo 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0`, and prints `Packages are already up to date` when nothing changed. When nothing changed but an update printed a warning, for example because npm left the old version installed after resolving stale registry metadata, it prints `No packages were updated, see the warnings above` instead; in offline mode it prints `Skipped package updates (offline mode)`. `PackageManager.update()` reports each changed package as a new `result` progress event whose `message` holds that line ([#11707](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11707), [#11711](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11711))
- Anthropic sessions now use message threads: each request sends only the new messages and the server continues from the previous reply, falling back to the full request when the conversation changed (for example after compaction or a tool list change). On by default for the `anthropic` provider on `api.anthropic.com`; set `compat.supportsMessageThreads` in `models.json` to enable it for gateways that forward the `thread` field, or to turn it off. Cache warming does not touch the session's thread ([#11545](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11545))
- `pi.registerMarkdownTransformer()` takes an optional `{ messageTypes }` that selects the Markdown surfaces a transformer runs on. Besides user, assistant, and thinking Markdown, transformers can now opt into `custom` (custom messages and skill blocks), `summary` (branch and compaction summaries), and `changelog` (What's New, `/changelog`, the Extension Updates notice, and the Update Available note). Without options a transformer runs on user, assistant, and thinking Markdown as before. The built-in Mermaid renderer now also draws diagrams in expanded branch and compaction summaries
- `pi auth login <provider>` logs in to a provider from the shell without starting a session, for example `pi auth login radius`. It signs in with an account in the browser and exits; `--api-key` saves an API key instead, and `--no-browser` uses device code or copy-code sign-in instead. Logging in to Radius also configures the Radius MCP server. `pi auth logout <provider>` removes the stored credentials, like `/logout`
- `ctx.ui.custom()` overlays now honor the `blocked` option: pi reports blocked program status (OSC 7501) from when the overlay is shown until it calls `done()`, also while it is hidden with `setHidden()`. Closing one overlay keeps other open questions blocked ([#11816](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11816))
- Added the `qwen-token-plan-individual-cn` provider for Qwen Token Plan Individual on the China endpoint, using `QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_CN_API_KEY` ([#7989](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/7989) by [@bigoldcat123](https://github.com/bigoldcat123))
- Added Microsoft-Decision-1 classifier support through GitHub Copilot, including codemode `models.classify()` ([#11679](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11679) by [@Marvae](https://github.com/Marvae))
- Added `compat.promptCacheKeyMode` (`"auto"`, `"enabled"`, or `"disabled"`) to enable prompt cache keys for compatible proxies or omit them for endpoints that reject them. Set it in `models.json` when using pi ([#9442](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9442) by [@dannote](https://github.com/dannote))
- Added `compat.requiresNonNullAssistantContent` for OpenAI-compatible endpoints that require an empty string instead of `null` in assistant messages containing only tool calls. Set it in `models.json` when using pi ([#8118](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8118) by [@gaoyk19](https://github.com/gaoyk19))
- Added syntax highlighting for Dart, Nix, Groovy, and Gradle files in read and write views ([#11643](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11643))
- Added GLM 5.3 to the Qwen Token Plan Individual model allowlist ([#11658](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11658))
- Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`) to the `anthropic` provider ($8/$40 per million input/output tokens, 1M context, 128K output). Like Fable 5.1 it uses per-message effort and mid-conversation system messages; requests its safety classifiers refuse before any output are answered by Claude Opus 5 through server-side fallback and billed at Opus 5's price. Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on other providers, such as OpenRouter's `anthropic/claude-fable-5.2`, get the same per-message effort support

### Changed

- The default model for the `anthropic` provider is now Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) instead of Claude Opus 4.8
- Default models moved to newer models at the same or a lower price: `amazon-bedrock` Claude Opus 5.5, `azure` GPT-6.1 Sol, `google` and `google-vertex` Gemini 4 Argon, `vercel-ai-gateway` GLM 5.3, `baseten` GLM 5.3, `minimax` and `minimax-cn` MiniMax-M3, `qwen-token-plan` and `qwen-token-plan-cn` Qwen3.8 Max, `opencode-go` Kimi K3.1 Pro, and Kimi K2.7 Code instead of Kimi K2.6 for `moonshotai`, `moonshotai-cn`, `huggingface`, `opencode`, `openrouter`, `cloudflare-workers-ai` and `cloudflare-ai-gateway`
- `cacheWarming` now defaults to `"idle"` instead of `"streaming"`: pi also keeps eligible prompt caches warm for up to 30 minutes between agent runs, but only when a refresh is expected to pay for itself. Set `"cacheWarming": "streaming"` in global settings for the previous behavior
- Consecutive cache warms now show as one `Cache warmed: $<total>` line with the cumulative cost instead of one line per warm
- The OpenAI Codex provider is shown as "OpenAI Codex" again instead of "OpenAI Codex (legacy)" in `/login` and the model selector
- The `/login` and `/logout` provider lists and `/login <provider>` completions now show the preferred partners Radius and OpenRouter first, then all other providers alphabetically. In the provider lists, partners are marked with `✦`, the selected Radius row shimmers in the Radius logo colors and the selected OpenRouter row glows in OpenRouter's brand color (lime on dark themes, violet on light themes)
- Upgraded terminal Mermaid rendering to support more diagram types, including pie charts, author-defined styles, and clickable labels on terminals with hyperlink support ([#8158](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8158) by [@xl0](https://github.com/xl0))

### Fixed

- Fixed the grep tool's `glob` matching from the folder pi was started in instead of from `path`: with `path: "repo"`, `glob: "migrations/main/*.js"` returned `No matches found` even though `repo/migrations/main/a.js` exists. Globs are now relative to `path`, the same form grep prints its results in, also when `path` is a symlink. A leading `./` (`./src/*.ts`) is ignored instead of matching nothing ([#11807](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11807), [#10998](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10998))
- Fixed prompt template arguments dropping apostrophes and merging words: an apostrophe inside a word, as in `doesn't`, no longer opens a quote; a quote with no closing match is kept as text; and `\"` inside `"..."` (or `\'` inside `'...'`) gives a literal quote ([#11861](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11861))
- Fixed the bash tool reporting only `Command timed out` when the command had already exited but a background process it started kept writing to its output until the timeout. The error now also reports the shell's exit code and when it exited ([#11613](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11613))
- Images in steering and follow-up messages, including `prompt()` while streaming, are now resized like images in idle prompts instead of being sent and saved at full size ([#11738](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11738))
- A failed token refresh of an MCP connection no longer registers an OAuth client or replaces the PKCE verifier of a sign-in in progress, which made that sign-in fail. MCP sign-in now refreshes the stored tokens with the stored client even when the loopback callback port changed, instead of registering a new client and opening the browser. Ctrl+C in `/mcp` and the `--timeout` of `pi mcp login` now also stop a sign-in while it waits up to 25 seconds for another pi process's token refresh, and a refresh lock that fails for another reason than that wait now fails the sign-in instead of opening the browser.
- Fixed `pi mcp list` reporting MCP servers with `"auth": { "provider": "<provider>" }`, such as Radius, as needing sign-in although the provider was signed in: the shell command sent no token. It now sends the provider's `/login` token and refreshes it when it expired. For these servers the sign-in hint names `/login <provider>` instead of `pi mcp login`, and `pi mcp login` and `pi mcp logout` point to `/login` and `/logout` instead of failing with "does not use OAuth"
- Fixed RPC mode ignoring an extension's `ctx.shutdown()` while idle, for example from a timer: the process kept running until the client sent another command. pi now shuts down right away when idle, and a shutdown requested by an extension command waits until the command's `prompt` response is written ([#11599](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11599))
- Fixed changelog notes repeating on every fresh launch when the installed package version has a prerelease suffix, such as `0.1.5-20261020.7`: the saved version was read as `0.1.0`, so the `0.1.1` to `0.1.5` notes counted as new each time. A saved version without `major.minor.patch` now shows no notes and is replaced by the installed version, instead of showing the whole changelog ([#11703](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11703))
- Fixed RPC mode cutting off shutdown cleanup, such as a pending MCP token refresh, when stdin closed and SIGTERM arrived together, which process managers like Paseo and systemd do. Pi lost the refreshed token and the MCP server revoked the sign-in. Once a shutdown has started, a stdin EOF or a single signal no longer interrupts it; a second signal still exits at once. Print mode likewise no longer dies from a signal that arrives during its final cleanup ([#11599](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11599))
- Fixed the grep tool reading every matched file into memory when `context` was set, which ran out of memory on large files; context now comes from ripgrep, which also fixes UTF-16 files and lone CRs in matched lines, and the match limit notice no longer appears when exactly `limit` matches exist ([#9276](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9276), [#11423](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11423))
- Fixed the find tool reporting the result limit when exactly `limit` files match, and `limit: 0` in find and ls returning every result or an empty listing; limits below 1 now mean 1 ([#7121](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7121))
- Fixed grep match lines, codemode output, compaction summaries of tool results, and MCP error and server summaries cutting an emoji or other non-BMP character in half when truncating, which left an invalid lone surrogate in the text ([#7121](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7121))
- Fixed the find tool on Windows returning no results for patterns with Windows separators such as `src\**\*.ts`, and for every path pattern such as `src/**/*.ts` with fd 10.5.1, which pi now downloads. Windows path patterns now match the same way with every fd version: `src/**/*.ts` also finds files directly in `src/`, and `src/*.ts` no longer finds files in subdirectories ([#9262](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9262))
- Fixed the read tool loading whole files into memory, which ran out of memory on large files even with `offset`/`limit`; it now streams the file and keeps only the shown lines. Custom `ReadOperations` can stream too by providing the new optional `createReadStream` ([#9654](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9654))
- Fixed OAuth logins such as `openai` and `anthropic` failing with `invalid_grant` after pi was stopped while it refreshed an expired token, for example an RPC client that stops pi right after startup while the background catalog refresh runs. The token endpoint had already replaced the refresh token, but pi exited before saving the new one. On exit, pi now waits for a token refresh in progress to be saved ([#11692](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11692))
- Fixed Ctrl+P not switching to the only model in scope (or the only available model) when the active model is a different one; it showed "Only one model in scope" instead. Cycling forward from a model outside the scope now also selects the first scoped model instead of skipping it ([#11806](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11806))
- Fixed `/reload` and session switches leaving extension overlays on screen when an extension had more than one `ctx.ui.custom({ overlay: true })` open: only the topmost overlay was removed, and the others kept focus and input although the extension that opened them was gone. All extension overlays, including hidden ones, are now removed and disposed; pi's own overlays stay open
- Fixed `/mcp` sign-in staying on "Connecting…" for minutes after a successful browser sign-in, with Ctrl+C doing nothing: pi waited for the browser to drop an unused connection to the OAuth callback port. The callback server now closes remaining connections when it shuts down ([#11311](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11311))
- Fixed pi aborting (`zsh: abort`) after repeated image reads, reported on macOS arm64 with Node 24.16. Each image resize starts a worker thread, and pi did not wait for it to stop, so the next resize started a new worker while the previous one was still shutting down. The crash is most likely a Node bug that this overlap triggers and could not be reproduced on Linux; image resizes now wait for the previous worker to stop, which adds about 15 ms per image ([#10695](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10695))
- Fixed `tool_search` and `searchTools()` not finding a tool by property names and descriptions behind a local `$ref`, as in MCP input schemas that put their models in `$defs`. Referenced definitions are read once, so recursive schemas do not loop, and definitions nothing references stay out of the search text ([#11803](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11803))
- Fixed the codemode `resolves to` summary of a tool leaving out field names behind a local `$ref`, for example `structuredContent?` instead of `structuredContent?: { results }` for MCP output schemas that put their models in `$defs` ([#11803](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11803))
- Fixed every codemode script failing with `URI malformed` when any callable tool, such as an MCP tool, had a `$ref` with a malformed percent escape (`#/$defs/%E0`) in its schema, even scripts that do not call that tool. The parameter now renders as `unknown` in the tool's declaration ([#11803](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11803))
- Fixed `ctrl+o` not expanding or collapsing the output of `!` and `!!` commands run while the agent is working. New `!`/`!!` output now starts in the current expand state, the output no longer disappears when a steering or follow-up message is queued, and it moves into the chat when the agent finishes instead of on the next submitted message ([#11875](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11875))
- Fixed resuming a session restoring an old thinking level after `/tree` navigated to before a `/thinking` change. Like the model, the live thinking level is now recorded on the new branch with the next prompt ([#11451](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11451))
- Fixed inline images in fullscreen mode showing only their first row in Orca, while regular mode showed them in full. Fullscreen now draws Kitty images after the rows they cover on every terminal, as it already did for WezTerm ([#11835](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11835))
- Fixed the edit tool rewriting the line endings of untouched lines in files with mixed CRLF/LF or lone CR line endings, and running out of memory on large files after the file was already written; the diff now covers only the changed lines and their surroundings and is computed before writing ([#8544](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8544))
- Fixed the Windows installer (`irm https://pi.dev/install.ps1 | iex`) aborting with `NativeCommandError` in Windows PowerShell 5.1 when npm or Node.js printed any warning, for example `npm warn Unknown user config` from an unknown `.npmrc` key. It failed before the action menu when migrating an npm installation, and during managed installs. An invalid `managed-install.json` also aborted the installer instead of being reported ([#11944](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11944))
- Fixed `pi update --models` failing with `Could not refresh model catalogs: openai: OAuth refresh failed for openai: ... invalid_grant` when a provider's login had gone stale. Built-in providers whose catalog comes from pi.dev, such as `openai`, no longer refresh their OAuth token for a catalog refresh at all. For providers that list models with the login, such as Radius and OpenRouter, a failed token refresh now prints a warning naming the provider and `pi auth login <provider>`, and the other catalogs still refresh; the command fails only for other errors, such as a network failure
- Fixed the powershell tool reporting `Command exited with code 1` under Windows PowerShell 5.1 when a native command succeeded but its stderr was redirected, as in `git push 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3`. Windows PowerShell 5.1 turns that stderr into error records; such commands now report the exit code PowerShell 7 reports ([#8842](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8842))
- Fixed deleting a paste marker with Backspace corrupting later short markers such as `[paste #2]`, causing the marker text to be submitted instead of its pasted content ([#11923](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11923))
- Fixed dropped provider streams reported as "cut short after the reply had begun" not triggering automatic retries ([#11879](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11879))
- Fixed the subagent extension example passing Bun's Windows virtual entry path as part of the prompt when spawning a compiled pi binary ([#11865](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11865))
- Fixed the model selector and llama.cpp Hugging Face search moving the selection when a background catalog refresh or search result arrives ([#9109](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9109))
- Fixed internal cursor markers leaking into terminal output, including with multiple markers or horizontally clipped content ([#9441](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9441) by [@muyiyr](https://github.com/muyiyr))
- Fixed the subagent extension example showing running tasks as completed, losing subprocess failure diagnostics, and failing to stop child processes on abort. Agent discovery and trust checks now use each task's working directory, and single and chain results are truncated without losing the full tool details ([#8250](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8250) by [@terrorobe](https://github.com/terrorobe))
- Fixed large pasted text being replaced by literal paste markers when switching editors, opening custom UI, or restoring queued messages ([#10146](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10146) by [@w-winter](https://github.com/w-winter))
- Fixed prompts and session-tree navigation overlapping during asynchronous input hooks, authentication, or branch summaries, which could install the wrong conversation context ([#9155](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9155) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))
- Fixed Claude Sonnet 5 requests sending an unsupported temperature parameter ([#7961](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/7961) by [@jingtao-wisdomgraph](https://github.com/jingtao-wisdomgraph))
- Fixed extensions loaded through symlinked paths failing to resolve their dependencies by resolving the entry file's real path before importing it ([#8112](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8112) by [@cad0p](https://github.com/cad0p))
- Fixed the plan-mode extension example missing completion markers in thinking blocks and common completion phrases, dropping formatted or long plan steps, and sending an extra model turn to acknowledge completion ([#7950](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/7950) by [@giannisCKS](https://github.com/giannisCKS))
- Fixed OpenAI Responses requests sending `session_id` instead of the documented `session-id` affinity header ([#11639](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11639))
- Fixed delivered image-only steering and follow-up messages remaining in the pending queue ([#8612](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8612) by [@wutongyuonce](https://github.com/wutongyuonce))
- Fixed cancellation during lazy provider loading or authentication being reported as an error instead of an abort ([#8635](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8635) by [@Mallikarjun-0](https://github.com/Mallikarjun-0))
- Fixed session runtime disposal tearing down extensions before active tools finished aborting and their results were recorded ([#9126](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9126) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))
- Fixed the session-tree search cursor not being shown or positioned for input methods ([#9157](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9157) by [@Perlence](https://github.com/Perlence))
- Fixed SDK and RPC reloads replacing extensions while a response or compaction was still running; reload now asks the caller to wait ([#9222](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9222) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))
- Fixed rendered edit diffs losing shared indentation when a change inserted text at the start of a line ([#9274](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9274) by [@dannote](https://github.com/dannote))
- Fixed `!` and `!!` commands omitting the truncation notice and full-output file link when earlier output chunks had been discarded ([#10165](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10165) by [@acmerfight](https://github.com/acmerfight))
- Fixed extension selection dialogs growing beyond the terminal height; they now show a scrolling window of up to ten options ([#11072](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11072) by [@DivineDominion](https://github.com/DivineDominion))
- Fixed `pi config` ignoring custom keybindings from `keybindings.json` ([#11651](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11651))
- Fixed concurrent OAuth refreshes through symlinked paths to the same `auth.json` by sharing the lock on the resolved file ([#11655](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11655))
- Fixed provider connection errors hiding their underlying cause, such as connection refusal or certificate errors, behind generic messages ([#11695](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11695))
- Fixed Ctrl+V not pasting clipboard images or text on Windows and WSL; both Ctrl+V and Alt+V are now default paste shortcuts there ([#11765](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11765))
- Fixed llama.cpp connection errors omitting the server URL and underlying network error ([#11745](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11745))
- Fixed Alacritty hyperlinks not being enabled when `TERM_PROGRAM` is unset; detection now also uses `TERM` and `ALACRITTY_WINDOW_ID` ([#11767](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11767))
- Fixed OpenAI Codex SSE retries retaining abort listeners after each backoff, causing listener buildup on repeated retries ([#11708](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11708))
- Azure OpenAI models now keep OpenAI's long-context price tier, so requests above 272K input tokens are costed at Azure's long-context rates ([#11948](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11948))
- Fixed Anthropic and Bedrock sending `strict: "prefer"` tools strict again on every request after Claude rejected them for exceeding its strict tool limits, which cost a rejected request (400) per turn. Later requests with the same `sessionId` now send those tools non-strict right away, until `cleanupSessionResources(sessionId)` ([#11626](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11626))
- Fixed tool arguments for `Type.BigInt()` and `Type.Undefined()` parameters being rejected: they convert as TypeBox converted them (`"42"` and `42` to `42n`, `null` to `undefined`), now that pi-schema supports both types. `Type.Void()` still rejects every JSON argument.
- Fixed Azure GPT-6 Astra, Luna, Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Terra using a 272K context window instead of the 1,050,000 tokens Azure Foundry deploys them with ([#11742](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11742))
- Fixed OpenRouter rejecting requests with a 400 (`This endpoint's maximum context length is ...`) for models whose output limit is close to the context window, such as DeepSeek flash. OpenRouter counts the input with its own tokenizer, which can be several percent higher than the provider's count, and pi left only 4,096 tokens spare. pi then treated the 400 as a context overflow and compacted the session, even at around 20% of the window. The default output limit now leaves 15% of the estimated input unused, and near a full window at most 32,768 output tokens are requested ([#10497](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10497))
- Fixed Anthropic non-strict tool schemas dropping root `$defs` and `definitions`, which left property `$ref`s pointing at nothing. Claude then produced wrong arguments for such tools (common in MCP servers), for example a JSON string instead of an object, and some Anthropic-compatible gateways rejected the request outright ([#9557](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9557))
- Fixed OpenCode Go Claude Haiku 5.5 failing with a 400 (`Invalid signature in thinking block ... bound to a different conversation`) after the tool list, system prompt, or earlier history changed, which left the session failing on every retry. OpenCode Go and Zen Claude 5.5 models, Opus 5, and Fable 5.1 now use per-message effort and send `thinking.block_binding: drop_block`, like the Anthropic provider ([#10954](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10954))
- Fixed Markdown displaying HTML comments (`<!-- ... -->`) as visible text ([#11710](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11710))
- Fixed codemode `console.*` output and thrown non-Error values printing `NaN`, `Infinity`, and `-Infinity` as `null` ([#11901](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11901))
- Fixed large MCP stdio messages being repeatedly copied and scanned as chunks arrived, causing slow tool responses ([#11761](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11761))
- Fixed MCP Streamable HTTP SSE replies with CR-only line endings failing with "stream ended without a response" ([#11764](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11764))
- Fixed oversized MCP SSE responses keeping their HTTP connections open after the message-size limit rejected them ([#11729](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11729))
- Fixed MCP stdio server subprocesses surviving disconnect or pi exit on POSIX when the server's main process had already exited ([#11721](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11721))
- Fixed MCP Streamable HTTP JSON replies bypassing message-size limits and HTTP errors buffering entire response bodies. Oversized replies and error-body content beyond the first 8 KiB are now cancelled ([#11335](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11335))
- Fixed valid tool arguments being rejected when their schema combined local `$ref`s with a relative root `$id`, such as `schemas/tool.json` ([#11697](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11697))
- Fixed the find tool starting an untracked `fd` process when cancelled during its parent-directory lookup ([#11974](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11974) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll))

name: Reasonix CLI v2.59.0
body: CLI archives built from the Studio release [studio-v2.59.0](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.59.0).

name: Reasonix Studio v2.59.0
body:
本版改为全屏设置页、统一界面图标、默认开启跨项目任务派发，修复思考计时、下拉框与工具注册表卡死等问题，并移除安卓版。

## 变更

- 设置改为全屏界面，左侧固定导航、右侧单列卡片铺满可用宽度；各分类的设置直接展开，通过胶囊定位，保留正在编辑的内容，并区分页面、卡片和字段标题（#15050）。
- 侧栏底部保留带文字的「设置」和「发送反馈」入口；已开启的快捷入口集中在图标与名称并列的卡片中，支持悬停、点击和键盘操作，沿用显示开关与排序（#15050）。
- 会话间消息与跨项目任务派发默认开启；显式关闭的用户配置继续保留（#15066）。
- 界面中文改用随包的 Noto Studio 字体，不再落到系统字体：Windows 上不再由只有常规和粗两档的微软雅黑渲染，500 和 600 字重在中文上也能呈现层次（3844e7e55）。

## 修复

- 发送、停止和浏览器导航按钮统一使用标准图标，修正停止方块过小的问题；手机端使用明确的停止符号，并正确弱化不可发送状态，外部打开按钮更易辨认（#15050）。
- 导航栏选中态改为主题浅底色、清晰图标和轻边框，修复主题包下突兀的实心色块（#15050）。
- 修复更新说明的语言按钮显示 `settings.text` 的问题，正确显示「简体中文」和「English」（#15050）。
- 修复语言等下拉框的文字偏上问题，让文字与箭头垂直对齐（#15050）。
- 切换模型或重载扩展后，仍可派发任务、打开项目并接收配对会话的回信（#15066）。
- 优化模型选单的拥挤布局：模型名单独一行，协议和「读图」标签放在下一行，连接状态保持完整；长服务商地址不再撑出横向滚动条（#15040，关联 #15012）。
- 合并工作台新标签页中重复的「资源管理器」和「文件…」入口；打开资源管理器即可直接搜索文件（#15040）。
- 修复模型服务设置中容量数值、继承提示及计费方式被裁切的问题；价格输入框与币种选择框统一高度，按实际可用宽度和字号调整列数，铺满表单区域。订阅计费选项使用简短名称，并保留完整说明（#15054）。
- 修复任务完成后旧思考卡片仍显示「思考中」并持续计时的问题。工具开始调用时停止思考计时，同一段回复中的交错事件不再拆出遗留卡片；后台会话确认结束前会先处理缓冲文字，重新打开会话时保留已记录的耗时（#15057）。
- 将界面中的字符、emoji 和通用手绘图标统一为 Lucide 图标，覆盖导航、设置、模型菜单、工具卡片、附件、预览和窗口操作。搜索、读文件、列目录、等待、终止、编辑与删除使用对应的图标；自定义服务和打开程序的入口不再使用首字母占位，并统一图标尺寸与对齐（#15063）。
- 修复对话向下滚动、展开的「执行过程」标题吸在顶部时，背景是透明的，导致标题和下面滚上来的执行内容叠在一起、两行文字重叠显示的问题：吸顶的标题现在用对话区的底色盖住它下面的内容（#15044）。
- 修复设置里的下拉框（比如「按用途选择模型」里的「使用模型」）选中很长的名字时，文字自动换成好几行、溢出下拉框的问题：现在名字保持在一行里，放不下就截断，不再撑出框外（#15041）。
- 修复设置、模型服务、用途选模型等页面里所有下拉框中，已选的文字偏向框的上沿、没有在垂直方向居中的问题（Windows 和 macOS 上都出现过）：现在文字在框里上下居中（#15041）。
- 修复技能目录里的文档文件（比如 `skills/某技能/README.md`、`skills/某技能/子目录/README.md`）被误报成"没有描述，会加载但不会出现在技能索引里"的警告弹窗：这些嵌套的文件本来就不会被当成技能，现在只对真正保留下来的技能说这句话（#15045）。
- 修复工具注册表的读锁被重复获取、在另一处同时注册或移除工具时可能整体卡死的问题；此前启用 MCP 或延迟加载能力的会话偶尔会一直显示「任务正在运行」（发现于 d09a7c557c 的测试）。

## 移除

- 移除安卓版：发布页不再提供 `ReasonixMobile-<版本>.apk`，已安装的安卓应用不会再收到更新（dcee062）。

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## Changed

- Settings fills the application window with fixed desktop navigation and full-width cards in one column. Category controls stay expanded, pill navigation preserves drafts, and page, card and field headings have distinct levels (#15050).
- The sidebar footer keeps labelled Settings and Send feedback rows. Enabled shortcuts appear in an icon-and-name card available by hover, click and keyboard, preserving saved visibility and order (#15050).
- Session messaging and cross-project task dispatch are enabled by default; explicit user opt-outs are preserved (#15066).
- Chinese text in the interface now uses the bundled Noto Studio face instead of the system font. On Windows it is no longer drawn in Microsoft YaHei UI, which has only regular and bold, so the 500 and 600 weights show on Chinese text too (3844e7e55).

## Fixed

- Send, stop and browser navigation controls use standard icons with balanced sizing. Stop keeps the same square on phones, disabled Send looks inactive, and opening a page externally has a clearer icon (#15050).
- Selected navigation items use a subtle theme tint, readable icons and a light border instead of a solid accent block in theme packs (#15050).
- Release-note language buttons display their language names instead of the untranslated `settings.text` key (#15050).
- Text in language and other drop-down controls aligns vertically with the arrow (#15050).
- Keep cross-project dispatch, project opening and paired replies available after model switches or extension reloads (#15066).
- Model names have their own line; protocol and image badges sit below without squeezing connection status. Long provider endpoints stay within the menu (#15040; refs #15012).
- The workbench's duplicate Explorer and Find a file entries are merged. Opening Explorer focuses the file search (#15040).
- Provider settings display complete capacity values, inheritance hints and billing choices. Price inputs and currency pickers share a consistent height, and their columns fill the form while adapting to its width and text size. Subscription billing uses a shorter option label with the full explanation underneath (#15054).
- Completed thoughts no longer keep counting as if they were still running. Thinking stops when a tool call begins, interleaved events keep one response together, and background panes drain buffered text before adopting an idle status. Reopened sessions retain the recorded duration (#15057).
- Replaced character, emoji and hand-drawn interface icons with Lucide across navigation, settings, model menus, tool cards, attachments, previews and window controls. Search, file reads, directory listings, waiting, stopping, editing and deletion now have distinct semantic icons. Custom services and program launchers use icons instead of initials, with consistent sizing and alignment (#15063).
- When an open "Work" heading stuck to the top while the conversation scrolled, its background was transparent, so the rows scrolling beneath it showed through and two lines of text overlapped. The stuck heading is now painted in the conversation's own colour (#15044).
- A long chosen name in a Settings drop-down, such as the model in "Choose a model for each purpose", wrapped over several lines and spilled out of the box. It now stays on one line and is cut off when it does not fit (#15041).
- The chosen text in every drop-down in Settings, model services and the per-purpose model table sat against the top edge of its box instead of the middle, on Windows and macOS alike; it is now centred vertically (#15041).
- Documentation files inside a skill folder, such as `skills/some-skill/README.md` or one a level deeper, no longer raise the warning that a skill "has no description: it will load but won't appear in the skills index". Such nested files are never loaded as skills; the warning now appears only for a skill that is kept (#15045).
- The tool registry no longer takes its read lock twice while building a turn's tool list. A concurrent tool registration or removal could deadlock it, leaving sessions with MCP or deferred capabilities stuck on "task running" (found by the test in d09a7c557c).

## Removed

- The Android app is discontinued: releases no longer carry `ReasonixMobile-<version>.apk`, and installed copies receive no further updates (dcee062).

## What's Changed
* fix(studio): improve model layout and merge duplicate file entry by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15040
* fix(studio): expand settings and clarify navigation controls by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15050
* fix(studio): size provider fields to their available space by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15054
* fix(studio): settle thinking clocks at response boundaries by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15057
* fix(studio): replace character icons with semantic Lucide icons by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15063
* fix: enable cross-project dispatch and retain runtime bindings by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15066


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.58.1...studio-v2.59.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。
